passages.interpretation: The disabled Action requires staged candidate state, false security hold, and ready related slot. Its complete locked check collection is exact-candidate scoped, bounded at 12 with overflow ineligible, requires at least two checks, rejects any non-passed check, and requires a sum no greater than 600. Non-null stored elapsed seconds have an enforced nonnegative check constraint; missing relationships or facts refuse through scoped loading and eligibility failure rather than a cached or partial total.

passages.interpretation: One compiled Action changes candidate_state to sealed and atomically changes the scoped related slot_state to consumed under Runner conflict protection. Both compiled effects advance their reviewed version counters in the same guarded transaction. The candidate slot_id has an unconditional unique key, supporting the required one-candidate-per-slot relationship; the verified relationship preserves tenant and principal scope.

passages.interpretation: Automatic approval applies only when the derived complete-check total is at most 120 seconds. The operator confirmed that tenant exactly identifies the software organization and the organization count is shared across coordinators. Valid requests exceeding either cap or the fast threshold use one release_supervisor approval; invalid eligibility is refused before human fallback.
